content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Cost Optimization Review - Aerospace Manufacturing Operations
agenda_items: Assessment of strategic sourcing opportunities for titanium and composite materials
Analysis of manufacturing efficiency gains from automation initiatives
Discussion of workforce restructuring timeline and change management approach
Review of supply chain consolidation progress across North American facilities
key_decisions: Delayed closure of legacy facility by 6 months to ensure seamless production transfer and customer commitments
Approved consolidation of three regional distribution centers into single hub facility to achieve 18% reduction in logistics costs
attendees: David Kowalski, Director of Operational Excellence
Yuki Tanaka, VP of Strategic Planning
Marcus Okonkwo, VP of Manufacturing Operations
